body.message:
The photos are real, yes. It's a fully furnished apartment in JVC with the standard building amenities (pool, gym, etc.), the full details are in the listing.

June 18 works for move-in, one month is fine, and the rate is all-inclusive (water, electricity, internet, VAT). Security deposit is AED 1,000, refundable after check-out. No agency fees.

It's available now, what day would you like to come see it?
